scope: OVERDOSE overlap-width profile control; no extraction or candidate generation

decision.reason: Measured overlap-width profiles are geometry scaffolding only: active profiles are two/three-slot phrase-width measurements, p75 is a separate four-slot control, mirror variants flip edge bias, and no checked source witness names an overlap-width, ratio, or coverage-profile rule.
decision.nextMove: Keep overlap-width profiles as a registration diagnostic only. Reopen extraction only with distinct source-backed wording that names measuring overlap width, coverage ratio, or profile order.
